name: EIGOS
description: Delegate only tasks matching the enabled skills below. EIGOS preserves task identity, asks for missing inputs and returns service-specific deliverables. Use explicit service IDs in structured submissions. Connecting this agent does not authorize purchases, sending or payments. No general shopping or coffee ordering capability is currently available.

skills.name: Prepare a task brief
skills.description: Delegate when the requested deliverable is a structured task brief with a goal and acceptance criteria. Supply goal and deliverable, or answer the follow-up question. Returns a JSON brief with execution=not_started. Does not execute the underlying goal, research, buy, send or book anything.
examples: Prepare a supplier-comparison task brief; the deliverable should specify three suppliers, price, capacity and source requirements.

skills.name: Assess and execute a local CSV audit through EIGOS
skills.description: Delegate a CSV data-quality audit in natural language. EIGOS uses its versioned CSV ontology to assess scope, asks for a missing filename, inspects the configured local file, and proposes a hash-bound plan. Only supports UTF-8 CSV with record_id, email, amount_cny, event_date, 1–1000 records and at most 1 MiB. Checks missing values, duplicate record_id and email/amount/date formats; extra columns are not audited. A2A AUTH_REQUIRED requests confirmation through POST /tasks/{taskId}/authorize using the authenticated connection and the exact quoteId/quoteDigest/action from the task. No credentials in chat. After confirmation, local simulated payment and deterministic auditing run; independent verification gates completion. Unsupported goals are rejected, not converted into documents. No real payment, coffee purchases, external research or data repair. Local development only.
examples: 用 EIGOS 审计配置目录中的客户 CSV，先确认是否能承接。
Audit sample.csv for missing values, duplicate IDs and invalid email, amount and date formats.

skills.name: CSV data quality audit with simulated payment
skills.description: Delegate only an explicitly requested local CSV audit simulation. Supply goal and either a supported synthetic datasetId or a fileName in the configured local input directory. Follow-up confirmation requires action=confirm_simulated_payment, quoteId and quoteDigest from the task quote. Returns an audit report with independent checks and simulated remediation. Local non-production only; no real payment or Alipay connection. File input requires the local development identity.
examples: {"service":"data.quality.audit.simulated","goal":"Audit the synthetic CSV and report invalid values","datasetId":"invalid-values-v1"}
